name: Shiori no Kotoha ~Misshitsu Toshokan no Ikenie~
original_name: シオリノコトハ ～密室図書館の生贄～
source:
At the end of a deep forest, there was a large library with European-style architecture.
Azuma Kenji drops by the library whenever he finds time. The reason why Kenji, who doesn't usually read books, comes by so much is because of the girl who works at the library, Tokita Shiori.
Kenji falls in love with her at first sight, and spends his days in the library reading and watching Shiori. One day, Kenji falls asleep and is awakened by the sound of an emergency bell...
The area was pitch black and the doors would not open...the library had turned into an inescapable prison.
Kenji's life changes drastically as a result of his involvement with her...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008115.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
在一片密林深处，有一座欧式建筑风格的大型图书馆。
东贤治一有时间就会去图书馆。平时不看书的贤二之所以会出现这么多，是因为在图书馆工作的女孩时田诗织。
贤治对她一见钟情，每天都在图书馆读书和观看诗织。有一天，健二睡着了，被紧急铃声吵醒了……
周围漆黑一片，门打不开……图书馆变成了一座无法逃脱的监狱。
健二的生活因与她的交往而发生了巨大的变化……
